meta.name: offensive-ssti
meta.description: Dense description covering Server-Side Template Injection across Jinja2, Twig, Freemarker, Velocity, Pebble, Smarty, Mako, Handlebars, ERB, Thymeleaf, EJS, Pug. Engine fingerprinting, filter bypass, blind exploitation, WAF evasion, SSTI-to-RCE chains. Tools: tplmap. CWE-1336. MITRE T1190. Use when testing template rendering endpoints or exploiting template injection for code execution.

copy.tagline: 挖掘并利用模板注入漏洞，获取服务器代码执行权限
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是安全测试人员,需要检测和利用模板注入漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Exploit template injection vulnerabilities to run code on servers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a security tester needing to detect and exploit template injection flaws.

howto.what: Claude 会执行服务端模板注入(SSTI)测试:向网址参数、表单、请求头注入探测代码,判断是否被当作模板执行;识别引擎(Jinja2、Twig 等);用对应方法读取文件、泄露配置或执行命令;可绕过过滤/WAF,给出非破坏性验证例子。
howto.when: 当用户要求测试应用的模板渲染功能是否存在服务端模板注入(SSTI)漏洞,或要求利用模板注入实现代码执行时触发。

say.text: 帮我检测 example.com 的模板渲染端点是否存在SSTI漏洞
say.note: Claude 会注入探测载荷并分析响应。

say.text: 用 tplmap 测试这个模板注入点并尝试执行命令
say.note: Claude 会借助 tplmap 进行自动化利用。

say.text: 针对 Jinja2 模板注入,给我一个读取 /etc/passwd 的载荷
say.note: Claude 会提供 Jinja2 的利用链。

howto.what_en: Claude performs SSTI attacks: injects probes into URL params/forms/headers; fingerprints engine (Jinja2, Twig, etc.); uses chains for file read/config leak/RCE; bypasses filters/WAF; outputs non-destructive PoC.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to test template rendering endpoints for SSTI vulnerabilities, or to exploit template injection for code execution.

say_en.text: Check if example.com's template rendering endpoint has SSTI vulnerability
say_en.note: Claude will inject probes and analyze the response.

say_en.text: Use tplmap to test this template injection point and try to execute a command
say_en.note: Claude will leverage tplmap for automated exploitation.

say_en.text: For Jinja2 template injection, give me a payload to read /etc/passwd
say_en.note: Claude will provide the Jinja2 exploitation chain.
